question: Can a neural network whose weights are tuned by a genetic algorithm learn to guide beam search better than hand-designed scoring heuristics when finding the longest common subsequence across many sequences under per-position gap restrictions?
gold_title: Neuro-Evolved Heuristics for Variable Gapped Common Subsequence Identification
notes: Abstract reports that a hybrid of learned and hand-crafted heuristics outperforms existing methods; it does not establish that the learned heuristic alone beats hand-crafted scoring.

question: How can a malicious server in federated learning recover clients' private training data when they fine-tune a model using low-rank adapters and only share adapter gradients, without relying on costly adversarial pretraining or limits on the number of tokens?
gold_title: MineGrad: Gradient Inversion Attacks on LoRA Fine-Tuning
notes: Gold abstract describes analytical gradient inversion of LoRA updates by a malicious server, including no adversarial pretraining or token-rank limit.

question: Which way of injecting a knowledge graph into RL is safe when the graph is wrong — masking actions, reward shaping, or state features?
gold_title: The Mechanism Matters: When Knowledge Graphs Help Reinforcement Learning
notes: Gold abstract directly compares KG state features, action masking, and reward shaping under corrupted or incomplete graphs.

question: How can a binary classifier be trained to reject uncertain inputs as rarely as possible while guaranteeing that the false positive and false negative rates each stay below user-specified limits, and what are the statistical and computational guarantees for doing so with surrogate losses?
gold_title: Classification with Abstention Under Class-Conditional Error Constraints
notes: Gold abstract covers minimizing abstention under separate class-conditional error limits, surrogate losses, and statistical/computational guarantees.

question: How well can off-the-shelf content moderation tools and language models distinguish graded levels of suicide risk in online forum posts, rather than just flagging whether a post is concerning, when judged against a psychiatrist's severity ratings?
gold_title: Beyond the Flag: Clinical Framing Closes the Moderation Gap in Suicide Risk Measurement
notes: Gold abstract evaluates ordinal suicide-risk severity against psychiatrist labels and compares moderation APIs with LLMs.

question: Which attention heads make chatbots just agree with whatever opinion the user states, and can you remove them without hurting accuracy?
gold_title: Tracing mechanisms of sycophantic agreement in language models
notes: Gold abstract identifies attention heads carrying user-opinion signals and reports ablation reducing sycophancy while preserving factual accuracy.

question: How can an exact cubic-regularized Newton step be computed per parameter tensor using the true block Hessian, matrix-free via Krylov/Lanczos methods, so it scales to very large neural networks like implicit neural representations?
gold_title: Blockwise Stabilized Adaptive Cubic Regularization with Subsolvers via Recurrence
notes: Gold abstract describes true block Hessians and matrix-free Lanczos/Krylov cubic steps for large parameter tensors.

question: How well can autonomous AI agents replicate the headline experimental results of recent machine learning conference papers when given differing amounts of author-released code, data, and model weights, and where do their attempts most commonly go wrong?
gold_title: RECLAIM: Can Agents Reproduce the Claims of Machine Learning Papers?
notes: Gold abstract reports agent reproduction rates by released-artifact tier and analyzes the common failure mode.

question: Is there a trick to initialize new semantic ID tokens from cluster centroids instead of random vectors when fine-tuning an LLM for recommendation?
gold_title: Preserving Item Semantics for Free: Rethinking Token Initialization in LLM-Based Generative Recommendation
notes: Gold abstract proposes centroid-based semantic-ID token initialization and compares it with random initialization.

question: Can a student model be distilled from a teacher on its own rollouts using only questions that the model itself generates, with no external dataset or seed examples, and how does that compare to training on the full real prompt set?
gold_title: Data-Free On-Policy Distillation: How Far Can We Go Without External Data?
notes: Gold abstract tests self-generated questions without seed data and compares data-free OPD with full-data OPD.

question: How can an LLM-based agent decide how much reasoning effort to spend as a task unfolds across planning, tool calls, and memory lookups, so that it avoids both wasted computation and incomplete answers?
gold_title: Don't Overthink, Don't Underthink: Toward Adaptive Reasoning in Agentic AI
notes: Abstract diagnoses over- and under-reasoning but proposes no concrete adaptive policy for deciding effort during an agent workflow.

question: Is there a biomedical multi-hop QA agent that evolves itself by editing reasoning templates in memory and uses a trained retrieval policy, rather than rewriting its whole prompt?
gold_title: SSE-Bio: A Structured Self-Evolving Agent with Agentic Retrieval Policy for Multi-Hop Biomedical Reasoning
notes: Gold abstract combines fine-grained reasoning-template edits with a trained retrieval policy for biomedical multi-hop QA.

question: How can interventions on the residual stream, such as grafting a single direction at one layer or replaying cached password key/value activations, restore capabilities that language models deliberately hide on evaluations?
gold_title: A Causal Model for Locating and Unlocking Sandbagging in Model Organisms
notes: Gold abstract covers both single-direction residual-stream grafting and cached password key/value context grafting. Reference-Grafting Matches Fine-Tuning covers only the former.

question: How can I build a large pretraining corpus for a niche domain like mathematics when filtering general web archives yields very little relevant content and misses many relevant pages that the archives never captured?
gold_title: Data Scout: Targeted Web Crawling for Domain-Specific Pretraining Corpora
notes: Gold abstract describes targeted domain crawling and quantifies math-page relevance and CommonCrawl omissions.

question: Is there a paper comparing prompting, sparse autoencoder features, and probes for steering LLM agents' risk and altruism behavior in social science simulations?
gold_title: Interpreting and Steering LLM Agents for Social Simulations
notes: Gold abstract compares prompting, SAE features, and probes for steering risk attitudes and altruism in social simulations; title overlap remains below the review threshold.

question: How do published AI value alignment papers conceptualize and operationalize human values, and how often do they define values versus relying on preferences as a proxy?
gold_title: Toward a Theory of Value in AI Alignment
notes: Gold abstract reports an annotation of 94 value-alignment papers, finding that most leave values undefined and use preferences as a proxy.

question: How can I swap out self-attention layers in an already-trained small language model with a cheaper recurrent local-processing substitute, one layer at a time, while verifying that hidden-state fidelity and loss don't degrade and undoing any layer that fails?
gold_title: TinyCeNN-LM: Quality-Gated Conversion of Pretrained Attention with CeNN-Inspired Cellular-Recurrent Layers
notes: Gold abstract describes layerwise attention conversion with representation/NLL gates and accept-or-rollback validation.

question: federated learning for brain tumor segmentation with differential privacy noise at the server and similarity-based weighting of client updates?
gold_title: Similarity Weighted Aggregation with Global Differential Privacy for Federated Brain Lesion Segmentation
notes: Gold abstract combines server-side Gaussian DP noise and similarity-weighted aggregation for federated brain-tumor segmentation.

question: Can filtering on-policy model responses down to a tiny subset using agreement among several specialized LLM judges yield better preference-optimized models than training on the full unfiltered preference data?
gold_title: Less Data, Better Alignment: Data-Centric Multi-Evaluator Agreement for Preference Optimization
notes: Abstract supports consensus filtering to a 3.45% subset and comparisons with SimPO, but does not report a controlled comparison against the full unfiltered preference dataset.

question: How many samples are theoretically needed for step-by-step pruned search guided by a model's own token likelihoods to retain the best reasoning path, and can its dependence on distribution coverage be improved compared with whole-sequence sampling-and-selection approaches whose requirements blow up exponentially with response length?
gold_title: Provable Test-Time Scaling for Beam Search in LLM Reasoning
notes: Gold abstract gives a quadratic vanilla-beam lower bound, nearly linear CF-Beam coverage dependence, and comparison with whole-sequence selection.
